name: stomach
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. One SQUARE standalone anatomy picture card for Body School ages 11–13. White background, centered organ with generous margins, softly shaded clean textbook illustration matching the digestion lesson, natural pink and red-brown tissues, friendly non-gory. NO words, labels, arrows, letters, border, watermark, body outline, or unrelated organs. Show a complete recognizable human J-shaped stomach, external anterior view, pale pink muscular sac with subtle surface folds and small blood vessels, short esophagus entering at upper left and short pyloric outlet curving out at lower right. No food, no liver, no full intestines. Whole organ comfortably inside frame.
